t: What is Mibor? Definition of Mibor, Mibor Meaning - The Economic Times
s: Definition: MIBOR is the acronym for Mumbai Interbank Offer Rate, the yardstick of the Indian call money market. It is the rate at which banks borrow unsecured funds from one another in the interbank market. At present, it is used as a reference rate for floating rate notes, corporate debentures, term deposits, interest rate swaps and forward rate agreements.
